step1_analysis.description: A two-transistor stacked NMOS structure, commonly used as a cascode amplifier or a single branch of an RF mixer. The bottom transistor acts as a transconductor while the top transistor acts as a common-gate current buffer to increase output impedance and reduce Miller effect.

paper_reference.title: Stacked Inductors and Transformers in CMOS Technology

dc_current.description: DC operating current of the cascode branch

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law approximation for SKY130 NMOS at Vgs=0.9V.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2 * Id / Vov = 2 * 310u / 0.48 = 1.29 mS. With a 2kOhm load, Gain = gm * Rload = 2.58 V/V = 8.2 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen load resistor in the testbench to keep both transistors in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC time constant at the output node. With Rload=2k and parasitic capacitance ~10fF, BW = 1 / (2*pi*R*C) = ~8 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode structure minimizes Miller capacitance, pushing the dominant pole to the output node.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the cascode amplifier measuring DC current, AC voltage gain, and 3dB bandwidth.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cascode Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Sources and Load
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN0 N0 0 0
Vbias LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
Vin LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac 1

* Load Resistor (2k ohms to keep M1 in saturation)
RL N1 VDD 2k

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let dc_current = -i(VVDD)
print dc_current

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)

* Measure midband gain at 100 kHz
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=100k

* Calculate 3dB drop target and measure bandwidth
let f3db_target = midband_gain - 3
meas ac bandwidth when gain_db=f3db_target fall=1

print midband_gain
print bandwidth
quit
.endc
.end
